title: A Django settings.py is served as source
summary: The Django settings module is downloadable as source, which carries the SECRET_KEY and the database configuration in plain text.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("SECRET_KEY") and body_contains("DATABASES") and body_differs(control) and not body_contains("<html")

remediate: Keep source out of the web root, and rotate the SECRET_KEY and any database credentials.
